Kit Penulisan Jurnal BerimpakImpact Journal Writing Kit

Kit ini ialah bengkel itu sendiri. Setiap kad membawa anda menulis satu bahagian manuskrip: tujuan, langkah retorik, ayat permulaan, prom AI yang siap dibina, dan gerbang semakan kendiri. Mulakan dengan K1 untuk mengetahui kad mana yang perlu dibuka dahulu.This kit is the workshop. Each card walks you through writing one part of your manuscript: its purpose, the rhetorical moves, sentence starters, a ready-built AI prompt, and a self-check gate. Start with K1 to find out which card to open first.

Trek ArtikelArticle track

Pensyarah, dan pelajar PhD atau Sarjana yang sudah mempunyai dapatan. Mendaki tangga sehingga penghantaran.Lecturers, and PhD or Master's students who already have results. Climbs the ladder to submission.

K0 → K2 → M1–M7 → K3 → K4

Trek Poster / CadanganPoster / Proposal track

Pelajar yang menghampiri pembentangan cadangan atau viva. Rangka menjadi kerangka cadangan dan poster.Students approaching a proposal defence or viva. The Blueprint becomes a proposal skeleton and a poster.

K0 → K2 → M1–M3 → K5

Peraturan AIThe AI rule Anda menulis dakwaan pertama. AI mengkritik, menyusun semula dan menyemak. Setiap fakta, nombor dan rujukan disahkan oleh anda sebelum masuk ke manuskrip.You write the first claim. AI critiques, reorganises and checks. You verify every fact, number and reference before it enters the manuscript.

Sistem labelLabelling system

Setiap jenis benda dalam kit mempunyai hurufnya sendiri, jadi satu kod hanya merujuk kepada satu perkara.Each kind of thing in the kit has its own letter, so a code only ever points to one thing.

Anatomi setiap prom kadAnatomy of every card prompt

  • PerananRole Siapa yang AI perlu jadi.Who the AI should act as.
  • KonteksContext Tajuk, soalan kajian, dakwaan dan jurnal sasaran anda (diisi automatik daripada K0).Your title, research question, claim and target journal (filled in automatically from K0).
  • TugasTask Satu tugas yang jelas.One clear task.
  • DrafDraft Teks yang anda tulis sendiri dalam kad ini.The text you wrote yourself on this card.
  • KekanganConstraints Jangan tulis semula keseluruhannya. Jangan reka rujukan.Do not rewrite it wholesale. Do not invent references.
  • Format & NadaFormat & Tone Bentuk jawapan yang anda mahu, dengan nada pewasit yang teliti.The shape of answer you want, in the tone of a careful reviewer.

Cara menggunakan fail iniHow to use this file

  • Fail ini berfungsi tanpa internet. Kerja anda disimpan secara automatik dalam pelayar ini sahaja.This file works offline. Your work saves automatically in this browser only.
  • Tukar bahasa di bahagian atas: BM, EN, atau kedua-duanya.Switch language at the top: BM, EN, or both.
  • Hidupkan 'Contoh kerja' untuk melihat manuskrip contoh di bawah setiap medan.Turn on 'Worked example' to see the sample manuscript under every field.
  • Di komputer bersama, eksport kerja anda dan kosongkan data sebelum pergi (Simpan & Eksport).On a shared computer, export your work and clear the data before leaving (Save & Export).
K1

Kad PenempatanPlacement Check

Lapan soalan ya/tidak untuk menentukan anak tangga anda dan kad yang perlu dibuka dahulu. Jawapan 'tidak' yang pertama menunjukkan titik mula anda.Eight yes/no questions that place you on the ladder and tell you which card to open first. Your first 'no' is your starting point.

  1. Saya boleh menyatakan soalan kajian saya dalam satu ayat.I can state my research question in one sentence.
  2. Saya telah memilih jurnal sasaran dan menyemak skopnya.I have chosen a target journal and checked its scope.
  3. Saya sudah mempunyai dapatan eksperimen (jadual atau rajah).I already have experimental results (tables or figures).
  4. Bahagian Pengenalan sudah didraf.The Introduction is drafted.
  5. Bahagian Kerja Berkaitan sudah didraf.The Related Work section is drafted.
  6. Kaedah dan Persediaan Eksperimen sudah didraf.The Method and Experimental Setup are drafted.
  7. Bahagian Dapatan ditulis berdasarkan jadual dan rajah.The Results section is written around tables and figures.
  8. Perbincangan, Kesimpulan dan Abstrak sudah didraf.The Discussion, Conclusion and Abstract are drafted.
K0

Kad Rangka ArtikelArticle Blueprint

Satu halaman yang menetapkan satu soalan, satu dakwaan dan satu sumbangan sebelum anda menulis apa-apa bahagian. Satu soalan, satu cerita, satu artikel.One page that fixes one question, one claim and one contribution before you write any section. One question, one story, one article.

Contoh kerja ini ialah manuskrip rekaan untuk tujuan latihan. Nombor dan rujukan bernombor adalah rekaan. Draf v1 ini mengandungi tiga kecacatan yang disengajakan. Cuba kesan ketiga-tiganya sebelum membuka contoh dalam K3.This worked example is an invented manuscript for training. Its numbers and numbered references are fictional. This v1 draft contains three deliberate defects. Try to find all three before opening the example in K3.
Namakan kaedah, masalah dan konteks.Name the method, the problem and the setting.
ContohExample
CS-StackBoost: A Cost-Sensitive Stacking Ensemble for Imbalanced Network Intrusion Detection
Berakhir dengan tanda soal. Boleh dijawab dengan bukti yang anda ada.Ends with a question mark. Answerable with the evidence you have.
ContohExample
Can a cost-sensitive stacking ensemble improve minority-class detection in network intrusion data without raising the false-alarm rate?
Jawapan kepada soalan kajian, dalam satu ayat yang boleh diuji.The answer to the research question, in one testable sentence.
ContohExample
CS-StackBoost raises macro-F1 and minority-class recall on UNSW-NB15 and CIC-IDS2017 while keeping the false-alarm rate at the level of the strongest single learner.
Pilih satu sahaja. Ia menentukan bukti yang pewasit akan cari.Pick one. It decides what evidence reviewers will look for.
ContohExample
Improvement to an existing method
Set data, eksperimen, jadual dan rajah yang sudah siap.Datasets, experiments, tables and figures already finished.
ContohExample
Experiments on two public benchmarks (UNSW-NB15, CIC-IDS2017); five baselines; macro-F1, G-mean and per-class recall; an ablation of the cost-sensitive layer.
Siapa yang rugi jika masalah ini tidak diselesaikan?Who loses if this problem stays unsolved?
ContohExample
The rarest attack classes (worms, shellcode, backdoors) are the costliest to miss and the least represented in training data, so standard detectors under-detect exactly the attacks that matter most.
Juga dipaparkan dalam K2. Sahkan kuartil semasa dalam JCR atau SJR bagi tahun terkini.Also shown on K2. Confirm the current quartile in JCR or SJR for the latest year.
ContohExample
Computers & Security (Elsevier)
Skop serupa, format yang mudah ditukar.Similar scope, easy to reformat for.
ContohExample
Expert Systems with Applications; IEEE Access
Satu baris bagi setiap bahagian utama: apa yang bahagian itu buktikan.One line per major section: what that section proves.
ContohExample
1 Intro: rare attacks are under-detected; cost-blind ensembles are the reason; we propose CS-StackBoost. 2 Related work: resampling, cost-sensitive learning and ensembles each fix part of the problem. 3 Method: base learners with class-cost weights, stacked by a cost-aware meta-learner. 4 Results: higher macro-F1 and minority recall on two benchmarks; ablation isolates the cost layer. 5 Discussion: why cost weighting at the meta level helps; limits on concept drift.

Kad Kesesuaian JurnalJournal Fit

Senarai semak risiko penolakan meja. Setiap kotak yang tidak ditanda ialah satu bendera risiko yang perlu diselesaikan sebelum penghantaran.A desk-rejection risk checklist. Every unticked box is a risk flag to resolve before submission.

Medan yang sama seperti dalam K0. Ubah di sini atau di sana; kedua-duanya dikemas kini.The same field as on K0. Change it here or there and both update.
Salin satu hingga tiga ayat daripada laman jurnal. Ayat ini dimasukkan ke dalam prom K2, Pewasit simulasi dan surat iringan.Copy one to three sentences from the journal page. They are inserted into the K2 prompt, the Simulated reviewer and the cover letter.
ContohExample
(Paraphrased for this example; paste the real sentences from the journal page.) The journal publishes research on computer and network security, including intrusion detection and machine learning for security.
Salin daripada senarai induk Scopus atau Web of Science, bukan daripada e-mel jemputan.Copy it from the Scopus or Web of Science master list, not from an invitation email.
ContohExample
https://www.sciencedirect.com/journal/computers-and-security
Contoh: Q1, JCR 2025. Kuartil berubah setiap tahun.For example: Q1, JCR 2025. Quartiles change every year.
ContohExample
[verify] JCR and SJR, latest edition
Langganan atau akses terbuka; semak perjanjian penerbitan UKM.Subscription or open access; check UKM's publishing agreements.
ContohExample
Subscription route available; open-access APC listed on the journal site
Penulis, tahun, DOI. Ini bukti skop, bukan senarai rujukan wajib.Author, year, DOI. This is evidence of scope, not a mandatory citation list.
ContohExample
[Three real articles found via the journal's search page, with DOIs checked]

Senarai semak risiko penolakan mejaDesk-rejection risk checklist

M1

PengenalanIntroduction

Meletakkan kajian dalam bidangnya, menunjukkan jurang yang khusus, dan menyatakan sumbangan dalam tiga hingga lima perenggan.Place the study in its field, show a specific gap, and state the contribution in three to five paragraphs.

Contoh kerja ini ialah manuskrip rekaan untuk tujuan latihan. Nombor dan rujukan bernombor adalah rekaan. Draf v1 ini mengandungi tiga kecacatan yang disengajakan. Cuba kesan ketiga-tiganya sebelum membuka contoh dalam K3.This worked example is an invented manuscript for training. Its numbers and numbered references are fictional. This v1 draft contains three deliberate defects. Try to find all three before opening the example in K3.

LangkahMoves

  1. WilayahTerritory Mengapa bidang ini penting dan apa yang sudah diketahui.Why the area matters and what is already known.
  2. JurangGap Apa yang khusus belum diselesaikan, dan mengapa ia menjadi masalah.What specifically remains unsolved, and why that is a problem.
  3. IsianOccupy Matlamat, pendekatan dan senarai sumbangan.Aim, approach and a list of contributions.

Ayat permulaanSentence frames

Klik untuk menyalin. Gantikan [kurungan] dengan kandungan anda.Click to copy. Replace the [brackets] with your content.

  • Menunjukkan kepentingan bidang.Establishes the importance of the area.
  • Menamakan andaian yang gagal; jurang yang lebih tajam daripada 'kurang kajian'.Names a failing assumption; a sharper gap than 'little research'.
  • Menghubungkan jurang dengan akibat.Links the gap to a consequence.
  • Peralihan daripada jurang kepada penyelesaian.Turns from gap to solution.
  • Membuka senarai sumbangan bernombor.Opens the numbered contribution list.
  • Ayat organisasi kertas (pilihan, bergantung pada jurnal).Paper organisation sentence (optional, depends on the journal).
Dua hingga tiga ayat dengan petikan.Two to three sentences with citations.
ContohExample
Network intrusion detection systems (NIDS) increasingly rely on machine learning to flag malicious traffic at scale [1, 2]. Ensemble methods such as random forests and gradient boosting now dominate benchmark leaderboards because they combine strong accuracy with modest tuning effort [3, 4].
Namakan andaian atau batasan yang khusus.Name a specific assumption or limitation.
ContohExample
These ensembles, however, optimise overall accuracy and therefore treat every misclassification as equally costly. In intrusion data the rarest classes, such as worms and shellcode, make up less than 1% of records, so a detector can score above 98% accuracy while missing most of them [5]. Resampling partly corrects the imbalance but distorts the decision boundary for the majority class [6].
Matlamat dan pendekatan dalam dua ayat.Aim and approach in two sentences.
ContohExample
This paper addresses this gap by proposing CS-StackBoost, a stacking ensemble in which both the base learners and the meta-learner are trained with class-specific misclassification costs.
Dua hingga empat butir. Setiap satu mesti dapat ditunjukkan dalam Dapatan.Two to four items. Each must be demonstrable in the Results.
ContohExample
(1) A two-level cost-sensitive stacking design for multi-class intrusion detection. (2) An evaluation on two public benchmarks against five baselines. (3) An ablation showing the contribution of the cost-aware meta-learner.

Kerja BerkaitanRelated Work

Menyusun kajian lepas mengikut pendekatan, bukan mengikut kertas atau tahun, dan berakhir dengan kedudukan kajian anda.Organise prior work by approach, not by paper or year, and end by positioning your study.

Contoh kerja ini ialah manuskrip rekaan untuk tujuan latihan. Nombor dan rujukan bernombor adalah rekaan. Draf v1 ini mengandungi tiga kecacatan yang disengajakan. Cuba kesan ketiga-tiganya sebelum membuka contoh dalam K3.This worked example is an invented manuscript for training. Its numbers and numbered references are fictional. This v1 draft contains three deliberate defects. Try to find all three before opening the example in K3.

LangkahMoves

  1. TemaThemes Dua hingga empat aliran pendekatan.Two to four lines of approach.
  2. Jadual perbandinganComparison table Bina jadual dahulu, tulis prosa kemudian.Build the table first, write prose second.
  3. SintesisSynthesis Setiap tema berakhir dengan batasan yang berkait dengan jurang.Each theme ends with a limitation tied to the gap.
  4. KedudukanPositioning Kerja yang paling hampir dan bagaimana kajian anda berbeza.The closest work and how yours differs.

Ayat permulaanSentence frames

Klik untuk menyalin. Gantikan [kurungan] dengan kandungan anda.Click to copy. Replace the [brackets] with your content.

  • Mengumumkan struktur tematik.Announces the thematic structure.
  • Memperkenalkan jadual perbandingan.Introduces the comparison table.
  • Menutup tema dengan batasan.Closes a theme with a limitation.
  • Kenyataan kedudukan.Positioning statement.
Satu baris bagi setiap tema.One line per theme.
ContohExample
A. Data-level resampling (SMOTE and variants) B. Algorithm-level cost-sensitive learning C. Ensembles for intrusion detection
Satu baris setiap kajian: Kajian | Kaedah | Data | Pengendalian ketakseimbangan | BatasanOne row per study: Study | Method | Data | Imbalance handling | Limitation
ContohExample
[7] | SMOTE + RF | NSL-KDD | oversampling | synthetic points blur class borders [8] | Cost-sensitive SVM | UNSW-NB15 | class weights | binary only [9] | Stacking (RF, XGB, LR) | CIC-IDS2017 | none | minority recall not reported
Satu perenggan setiap tema, berakhir dengan batasan.One paragraph per theme, ending with a limitation.
ContohExample
Resampling methods rebalance the training set before learning [6, 7]. They raise minority recall but generate synthetic records that may not correspond to valid traffic, and they leave the learner's loss function unchanged. A limitation shared by these studies is that the cost of missing a rare attack is never made explicit.
Namakan kerja paling hampir.Name the closest work.
ContohExample
The work closest to ours is [9], which stacks three learners for CIC-IDS2017 but trains every level with uniform costs. Unlike [9], CS-StackBoost assigns class-specific costs at both the base and meta levels.

M3

KaedahMethod

Menerangkan kaedah yang dicadangkan dengan cukup terperinci supaya penyelidik lain boleh melaksanakannya semula.Describe the proposed method in enough detail for another researcher to reimplement it.

Contoh kerja ini ialah manuskrip rekaan untuk tujuan latihan. Nombor dan rujukan bernombor adalah rekaan. Draf v1 ini mengandungi tiga kecacatan yang disengajakan. Cuba kesan ketiga-tiganya sebelum membuka contoh dalam K3.This worked example is an invented manuscript for training. Its numbers and numbered references are fictional. This v1 draft contains three deliberate defects. Try to find all three before opening the example in K3.

LangkahMoves

  1. Gambaran keseluruhanOverview Rajah saluran paip dan satu perenggan ringkasan.Pipeline figure and a one-paragraph summary.
  2. KomponenComponents Langkah demi langkah, dengan notasi yang ditakrifkan.Step by step, with defined notation.
  3. AlgoritmaAlgorithm Pseudokod atau senarai langkah.Pseudocode or a step list.
  4. RasionalRationale Mengapa setiap pilihan reka bentuk dibuat; kerumitan.Why each design choice was made; complexity.

Ayat permulaanSentence frames

Klik untuk menyalin. Gantikan [kurungan] dengan kandungan anda.Click to copy. Replace the [brackets] with your content.

  • Merujuk rajah saluran paip.Points to the pipeline figure.
  • Mentakrifkan notasi pada penggunaan pertama.Defines notation at first use.
  • Rasional reka bentuk.Design rationale.
  • Menyatakan susunan pra-pemprosesan secara eksplisit.States the preprocessing order explicitly.
  • Analisis kerumitan.Complexity analysis.
Apa yang masuk, apa yang keluar, dan peringkat di antaranya.What goes in, what comes out, and the stages in between.
ContohExample
CS-StackBoost has three stages (Figure 1): preprocessing, a cost-sensitive base layer of four learners, and a cost-aware logistic meta-learner that combines their out-of-fold probabilities.
Takrifkan setiap simbol pada penggunaan pertama.Define every symbol at first use.
ContohExample
Preprocessing. Categorical features are one-hot encoded and numeric features are min-max scaled. To balance the classes, SMOTE was applied to the full dataset, after which the data were split 80:20 into training and test sets. Base layer. Each base learner h_k is trained with a cost matrix C, where C(i, j) is the cost of predicting class j for a record of class i.
Cukup untuk dilaksanakan semula.Enough to reimplement.
ContohExample
1. Fit preprocessing. 2. For k = 1..4, train h_k with cost matrix C using 5-fold out-of-fold predictions. 3. Train meta-learner g on the stacked probabilities with cost matrix C. 4. Predict with g(h_1(x), …, h_4(x)).
Satu sebab bagi setiap pilihan utama.One reason per major choice.
ContohExample
We place costs at the meta level as well as the base level because uniform-cost meta-learners re-weight the base predictions towards majority classes.

M4

Persediaan EksperimenExperimental Setup

Menjadikan penilaian adil dan boleh diulang: data, protokol, garis dasar, metrik, pelaksanaan dan ujian statistik.Make the evaluation fair and reproducible: data, protocol, baselines, metrics, implementation and statistical tests.

Contoh kerja ini ialah manuskrip rekaan untuk tujuan latihan. Nombor dan rujukan bernombor adalah rekaan. Draf v1 ini mengandungi tiga kecacatan yang disengajakan. Cuba kesan ketiga-tiganya sebelum membuka contoh dalam K3.This worked example is an invented manuscript for training. Its numbers and numbered references are fictional. This v1 draft contains three deliberate defects. Try to find all three before opening the example in K3.

LangkahMoves

  1. Set dataDatasets Sumber, saiz dan taburan kelas.Source, size and class distribution.
  2. ProtokolProtocol Pemisahan atau pengesahan silang, dan di mana pensampelan semula berlaku.Split or cross-validation, and where resampling happens.
  3. Garis dasarBaselines Termasuk pesaing terkini yang paling kuat.Including the strongest recent competitor.
  4. MetrikMetrics Sesuai untuk data tidak seimbang.Suited to imbalanced data.
  5. Pelaksanaan dan statistikImplementation and statistics Hiperparameter, benih, perkakasan, ujian kesignifikanan.Hyperparameters, seeds, hardware, significance tests.

Ayat permulaanSentence frames

Klik untuk menyalin. Gantikan [kurungan] dengan kandungan anda.Click to copy. Replace the [brackets] with your content.

  • Memperkenalkan set data.Introduces the datasets.
  • Mencegah kebocoran data.Prevents data leakage.
  • Garis dasar yang adil.Fair baselines.
  • Justifikasi metrik.Justifies the metrics.
  • Rancangan ujian statistik.Statistical test plan.
Sumber, bilangan rekod, taburan kelas.Source, record count, class distribution.
ContohExample
UNSW-NB15 (10 classes; worms 0.07% of records) and CIC-IDS2017 (15 classes; Heartbleed and Infiltration under 0.01%).
Di mana pensampelan semula berlaku berbanding pemisahan?Where does resampling happen relative to the split?
ContohExample
An 80:20 stratified train/test split, performed after class balancing (see Section 3).
Adakah pesaing terkini yang paling kuat dimasukkan?Is the strongest recent competitor included?
ContohExample
Random forest, XGBoost, SVM (RBF), MLP and AdaBoost, chosen because they are the most widely used learners in NIDS studies.
Ketepatan sahaja tidak mencukupi.Accuracy alone is not enough.
ContohExample
Macro-F1, G-mean, per-class recall and false-alarm rate.
Hiperparameter, benih, larian berulang, ujian.Hyperparameters, seeds, repeated runs, tests.
ContohExample
Python 3.11, scikit-learn 1.4, XGBoost 2.0; hyperparameters tuned by grid search; random seed 42.

DapatanResults

Melaporkan dapatan bermula daripada jadual dan rajah. Satu dakwaan bagi setiap jadual atau rajah, disokong oleh nombor.Report findings starting from the tables and figures. One claim per table or figure, backed by a number.

Contoh kerja ini ialah manuskrip rekaan untuk tujuan latihan. Nombor dan rujukan bernombor adalah rekaan. Draf v1 ini mengandungi tiga kecacatan yang disengajakan. Cuba kesan ketiga-tiganya sebelum membuka contoh dalam K3.This worked example is an invented manuscript for training. Its numbers and numbered references are fictional. This v1 draft contains three deliberate defects. Try to find all three before opening the example in K3.

LangkahMoves

  1. Jadual atau rajahTable or figure Apa yang ditunjukkan.What it shows.
  2. PemerhatianObservation Satu dakwaan utama.One main claim.
  3. BuktiEvidence Nombor, variasi dan ujian.Numbers, variability and tests.
  4. AblasiAblation Sumbangan setiap komponen.The contribution of each component.

Ayat permulaanSentence frames

Klik untuk menyalin. Gantikan [kurungan] dengan kandungan anda.Click to copy. Replace the [brackets] with your content.

  • Memperkenalkan jadual dengan variasi.Introduces a table with variability.
  • Dakwaan dengan nombor.A claim with a number.
  • Bukti kesignifikanan.Evidence of significance.
  • Dapatan ablasi.Ablation finding.
Kapsyen, satu dakwaan, nombor.Caption, one claim, numbers.
ContohExample
Table 3 reports macro-F1 for all methods. CS-StackBoost outperforms all baselines on both datasets, reaching 0.874 on UNSW-NB15 and 0.912 on CIC-IDS2017, compared with 0.842 and 0.889 for XGBoost.
Kapsyen, satu dakwaan, nombor.Caption, one claim, numbers.
ContohExample
Figure 3 shows per-class recall on UNSW-NB15. Recall for worms rose from 0.48 (XGBoost) to 0.71, and for shellcode from 0.62 to 0.80, while the false-alarm rate stayed at 1.9%.
Hanya jika ia menyokong dakwaan yang berbeza.Only if it supports a different claim.
Buang satu komponen pada satu masa.Remove one component at a time.
ContohExample
Replacing the cost-aware meta-learner with a uniform-cost one reduced minority recall by 0.09 on average (Table 4).

PerbincanganDiscussion

Menjawab soalan kajian, membandingkan dengan kerja lepas, menerangkan mengapa, dan menyatakan batasan dengan jujur.Answer the research question, compare with prior work, explain why, and state the limitations honestly.

Contoh kerja ini ialah manuskrip rekaan untuk tujuan latihan. Nombor dan rujukan bernombor adalah rekaan. Draf v1 ini mengandungi tiga kecacatan yang disengajakan. Cuba kesan ketiga-tiganya sebelum membuka contoh dalam K3.This worked example is an invented manuscript for training. Its numbers and numbered references are fictional. This v1 draft contains three deliberate defects. Try to find all three before opening the example in K3.

LangkahMoves

  1. JawapanAnswer Jawab soalan kajian secara langsung.Answer the research question directly.
  2. BandinganCompare Dengan kajian lepas yang dipetik.Against cited prior work.
  3. PenjelasanExplain Mekanisme yang munasabah, dilabel sebagai penjelasan.A plausible mechanism, labelled as explanation.
  4. BatasanLimits Batasan khusus dan ancaman kepada kesahan.Specific limitations and threats to validity.

Ayat permulaanSentence frames

Klik untuk menyalin. Gantikan [kurungan] dengan kandungan anda.Click to copy. Replace the [brackets] with your content.

  • Menjawab soalan kajian.Answers the research question.
  • Perbandingan dengan kerja lepas.Comparison with prior work.
  • Penjelasan yang berhati-hati.A cautious explanation.
  • Batasan yang khusus.Specific limitations.
Ayat pertama Perbincangan.The first sentence of the Discussion.
ContohExample
These results indicate that applying class-specific costs at both levels of a stacking ensemble improves minority-class detection without raising the false-alarm rate.
Sekurang-kurangnya dua bandingan yang dipetik.At least two cited comparisons.
ContohExample
This is consistent with [8], who found that class weighting improved recall for rare attacks in a binary SVM; however, unlike [8], we observe the gain in a ten-class setting.
Labelkan sebagai penjelasan, bukan fakta yang terbukti.Label it as explanation, not proven fact.
ContohExample
A plausible explanation is that a uniform-cost meta-learner learns to trust the base learners that are most accurate overall, which are also the ones most biased towards majority classes.
Khusus, dengan kesan yang mungkin.Specific, with the likely effect.
ContohExample
Several limitations should be noted. First, both benchmarks were captured in laboratory testbeds, so performance on live traffic with concept drift is untested. Second, the cost matrix was set by inverse class frequency rather than elicited from security analysts.

Kesimpulan & AbstrakConclusion & Abstract

Menutup dengan sumbangan dan dapatan utama, kemudian memampatkan keseluruhan kertas kepada abstrak lima ayat.Close with the contribution and key finding, then compress the whole paper into a five-sentence abstract.

Contoh kerja ini ialah manuskrip rekaan untuk tujuan latihan. Nombor dan rujukan bernombor adalah rekaan. Draf v1 ini mengandungi tiga kecacatan yang disengajakan. Cuba kesan ketiga-tiganya sebelum membuka contoh dalam K3.This worked example is an invented manuscript for training. Its numbers and numbered references are fictional. This v1 draft contains three deliberate defects. Try to find all three before opening the example in K3.

LangkahMoves

  1. KesimpulanConclusion Sumbangan, dapatan utama dengan nombor, implikasi, kerja masa depan.Contribution, key finding with a number, implication, future work.
  2. Abstrak lima ayatFive-sentence abstract Konteks, jurang, kaedah, dapatan, implikasi.Context, gap, method, result, implication.

Ayat permulaanSentence frames

Klik untuk menyalin. Gantikan [kurungan] dengan kandungan anda.Click to copy. Replace the [brackets] with your content.

  • Membuka kesimpulan.Opens the conclusion.
  • Dapatan utama.Key finding.
  • Kerja masa depan yang khusus.Specific future work.
Satu perenggan. Tiada petikan baharu.One paragraph. No new citations.
ContohExample
This paper proposed CS-StackBoost, a two-level cost-sensitive stacking ensemble for imbalanced intrusion detection. Experiments on UNSW-NB15 and CIC-IDS2017 showed higher macro-F1 than five baselines and a rise in worm recall from 0.48 to 0.71. Future work will elicit cost matrices from analysts and test the model under concept drift.
Mengapa bidang ini penting.Why the area matters.
ContohExample
Machine-learning intrusion detectors routinely miss rare attack classes, which are often the most damaging.
Apa yang kaedah sedia ada gagal lakukan.What existing methods fail to do.
ContohExample
Existing ensembles optimise overall accuracy and treat all errors as equally costly.
Apa yang anda cadangkan.What you propose.
ContohExample
We propose CS-StackBoost, a stacking ensemble that applies class-specific misclassification costs at both the base and meta levels.
Dengan nombor.With numbers.
ContohExample
On UNSW-NB15 and CIC-IDS2017, CS-StackBoost achieved macro-F1 of 0.874 and 0.912 and raised worm recall from 0.48 to 0.71.
Apa yang berubah untuk pengamal atau penyelidik.What changes for practitioners or researchers.
ContohExample
Making error costs explicit at every level of an ensemble is a simple way to detect rare attacks without extra false alarms.

Pustaka PromPrompt Library

Setiap prom diisi secara automatik daripada apa yang sudah anda tulis: tajuk, soalan kajian, dakwaan dan jurnal daripada K0, skop jurnal daripada K2, dan draf daripada kad berkenaan. Teks yang diambil diserlahkan supaya anda nampak dari mana ia datang sebelum menyalin.Every prompt fills itself from what you have already written: title, research question, claim and journal from K0, journal scope from K2, and the draft from the relevant card. Pulled-in text is highlighted so you can see where it came from before you copy.

Peraturan AIThe AI rule Anda menulis dakwaan pertama. AI mengkritik, menyusun semula dan menyemak. Setiap fakta, nombor dan rujukan disahkan oleh anda sebelum masuk ke manuskrip.You write the first claim. AI critiques, reorganises and checks. You verify every fact, number and reference before it enters the manuscript.

Kad Wasit & Pelan PemurnianReview Card & Revision Plan

Borang ulasan berstruktur yang mencerminkan gerbang setiap bahagian. Pengarang kemudian menukar tiga tindakan utama kepada Pelan Pemurnian bertarikh.A structured review form that mirrors each section's gate. The author then turns the top three actions into a dated Revision Plan.

Protokol meja wasit (35 minit setiap manuskrip)Reviewer-table protocol (35 minutes per manuscript)

  1. 5 minit · Pengarang membentangkan K0 (soalan, dakwaan, jurnal).5 min · The author presents K0 (question, claim, journal).
  2. 15 minit · Pewasit meneliti setiap bahagian dengan gerbangnya dan menandakan status.15 min · The reviewer walks each section against its gate and marks a status.
  3. 10 minit · Persetujuan tiga tindakan utama.10 min · Agree the top three actions.
  4. 5 minit · Pengarang menulis Pelan Pemurnian sementara pewasit beralih ke manuskrip seterusnya.5 min · The author writes the Revision Plan while the reviewer moves to the next manuscript.
